name: Discone Antenna
description: The discone is an ultra-wideband vertical antenna used for VHF/UHF scanning and monitoring. It consists of a disc above a cone and provides omnidirectional coverage with bandwidth ratios from 3:1 to 10:1.
modelingNotes: Disc diameter sets the upper frequency limit.
Cone length and angle determine the lower frequency limit.
Feed impedance is typically near 50 ohms.
